links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level)
links.effect: Responses had a low reading ease score and required a college-to-graduate level of comprehension.
links.quote: The responses had a low reading ease score and required a college-to-graduate level of comprehension.

links.outcome: Concordance of ChatGPT responses with AAO PPP guidelines, rated by specialists on 1-5 Likert scale
links.effect: Overall average score 4.9/5.0, high alignment with AAO PPP guidelines; lowest in surgical management; errors in diagnostic criteria, treatment options, and methodological procedures.
links.quote: ChatGPT achieved an overall average score of 4.9/5.0, suggesting high alignment with the AAO PPP guidelines.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's accuracy and readability on retinal disease questions assessed by clinical specialists, but does not test a deployment practice or guardrail.
